display_name: Isaac the Recluse of the Kyiv Caves

names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 14 Φεβρουαρίου, «Όσιος Ισαάκιος ο Έγκλειστος ο εκ Ρωσίας», with the rank words left off. The page prints a by-name in brackets in the life, «ο Όσιος Ισαάκιος (Τοροπτσάνιν)».

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding menologion day (30 September 2026).
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 14ης Φεβρουαρίου — «Όσιος Ισαάκιος ο Έγκλειστος ο εκ Ρωσίας»

attestations.note: The day's line calls him «ο εκ Ρωσίας», the one out of Russia, and his page puts his relics in the Lavra of the Caves at Kyiv, with a part of them at the Kudin monastery of Toropets. It gives no year of any kind.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding menologion day (30 September 2026).
